The Hongguang MINIEV family has sold over 1.95 million units, leading China's A00 EV segment for 71 straight months.
The fifth-generation Hongguang MINIEV launched in Indonesia at about ¥59,600, with a Toy Story 5 tie-in.
sina-news-inikshrm0978733.title: Hongguang MINIEV turns six as Wuling city-car users approach 3 million

points: The BMW X6 M is discounted by up to ¥380,000 nationwide, a 25.9% cut, with a starting price of ¥1,088,900.
The BMW X6 M sold just 3 units nationwide last month, with a consumer rating of 4.39.
Rival Porsche Cayenne sold 1,358 units last month. Prices are indicative; check local dealers.
sina-news-inikuwea8891226.title: New price war hits: BMW X6 M discounted by up to ¥380,000 nationwide

points: Xiaomi Auto delivered more than 30,000 vehicles in July.
The Pengcheng series is expected to launch in September, when pricing and trims will be announced.
Pre-order prices: Pengcheng N70 Max at ¥259,900 and N90 Max at ¥299,900.
yiche-09111926385.title: Xiaomi delivers over 30,000 vehicles in July; Pengcheng series expected in September

points: Li Auto delivered 30,468 vehicles in July, for 1,764,155 cumulative deliveries.
The next-generation Li L6 launched, and deliveries are set to pass 400,000 units in August.
The Li L9 launched in Kazakhstan with local production; cumulative deliveries exceed 300,000 units.
yiche-10111928300.title: Li Auto delivers 30,468 vehicles in July; cumulative deliveries reach 1,764,155

points: From August 1, FAW-Volkswagen offers a dual lifetime warranty to new buyers of all ICE and PHEV models.
Coverage includes the complete vehicle and original parts, with no time or mileage limit and nationwide service.
Previously limited to ICE SUVs, the benefit now extends to sedans and PHEV models.
yiche-10111928710.title: FAW-Volkswagen first in industry to offer dual lifetime warranty across the range

points: Leapmotor delivered 101,267 vehicles globally in July, up 102% year over year and past 100,000 for the first time.
The B01 and B10 launched July 16; the A10 completed hot-weather testing and the A05 opened blind pre-orders.
Leapmotor completed Mexican localization certification and began deliveries, with a limited-time August campaign.
yiche-11111929282.title: Leapmotor delivers 101,267 vehicles globally in July, topping 100,000 in a month for the first time

points: GAC Aion launched the AION Y Plus Black & White Warrior Edition on August 1 at a flat price of ¥89,800.
That is ¥10,000 below the previous entry trim, a new low for the series.
The commemorative edition keeps the core specification, emphasizing value and personalization for younger buyers.
yiche-11111929716.title: AION Y Plus Black & White Warrior Edition launches at a flat ¥89,800

points: HIMA delivered 45,046 vehicles in July and 286,000 units January–July, up 13.7% year over year.
Cumulative deliveries across all series passed 1.48 million units, with the AITO M9 alone above 300,000.
The Maextro V800 and V680 launch August 5, with Luxeed G9 pre-orders opening the same day.
yiche-11111929960.title: HIMA delivers 45,046 vehicles in July; cumulative deliveries reach 1.48M

points: Zeekr delivered 35,837 vehicles in July, up 111% year over year and a monthly record.
Zeekr's cumulative global user base surpassed 850,000.
The Zeekr 9X enters the Middle East as a full-vehicle export in H2; Mansory has ordered 200 units for a bespoke edition.
yiche-12111930670.title: Zeekr delivers 35,837 vehicles in July; global users pass 850,000

points: NIO delivered 35,934 vehicles in July, up 71.0% year over year.
By brand: NIO 20,008 units, Onvo 10,155 units and Firefly 5,771 units in July.
Deliveries totaled 227,057 units in the first seven months, an all-time high, for 1,224,649 cumulative.
yiche-12111932778.title: NIO delivers 35,934 vehicles in July; cumulative deliveries reach 1,224,649

points: XPeng Group delivered 38,027 vehicles in July, up about 4% year over year.
As of July, XPeng's cumulative global deliveries surpassed 1.2 million units.
XPeng now operates in 65 countries and regions, and plans to launch five models in Australia in H2 2026.
yiche-12111933020.title: XPeng delivers 38,027 vehicles in July, passing 1.2M cumulative deliveries globally

points: Voyah delivered 13,189 vehicles in July and 89,453 units January–July, up 31% year over year.
The Voyah Passion S topped 10,000 pre-orders within one hour and launches August 15 in Chengdu.
The Voyah Dreamer leads the ¥300,000–¥700,000 MPV segment; the Dreamer 9 targets the ¥500,000 flagship market.
yiche-13111934327.title: Voyah delivers 13,189 vehicles in July; Passion S launches August 15
